decision.admissible_bar: ts is on the timeframe's own UTC grid (ts % interval == 0), ts is strictly greater than the frozen end of its source timeframe, and the bar is CLOSED at the instant of the fetch (ts + interval <= server time). An open bar is counted and dropped, never stored as if it had closed.
decision.duplicate: the same ts seen twice in one fetch, or already stored: counted, kept once.
decision.gap: a missing grid slot between two stored bars is a gap. It is COUNTED and NEVER filled, interpolated or forward-filled; a decision bar that would sit inside a gap is still evaluated on the bars that exist, and any candidate that needs the missing history simply refuses (its own warm-up rule), which is visible.
decision.incomplete: a row whose OHLC block is internally impossible (high < low, high < open/close, low > open/close, non-positive price, non-finite) is counted and NOT stored; a corpus that stores a corrupt bar cannot be audited later.
decision.no_retrospective_change: the forward store is append-only: a bar is written once, and a later fetch that disagrees with a stored bar is recorded as a revision and does NOT overwrite it. The corpus the earlier WPs measured is never written to at all.
decision.not_claimed: a working forward pipeline is not evidence of an edge and not an admission: no metric computed here is compared against an admission criterion.
decision.observation_day: a UTC date with at least 90% of the bars the calendar expects for that timeframe, for that asset.
decision.out_of_order: a fetched row earlier than the last stored ts: counted and rejected.
decision.shadow_is_hypothetical: every fill the shadow books carries ``hypothetical: true`` and ``order_sent: false``. Nothing in this lane has an exchange client.
decision.stale: no bar has closed since the last stored bar: the run records ``no_new_data`` with the instant it checked, and reports zero new days.

verdict_vocabulary.OBSERVATION_RUNNING: fewer than 60 independent observation days: the lane reports what it saw and claims nothing about the edge.
verdict_vocabulary.OBSERVATION_STALLED: no new closed bar existed at the instant of the run.
verdict_vocabulary.PARITY_FAILED: the research budget and the runtime engine disagreed on an entry the runtime would have refused under a rule the research budget models.

prospective.not_counted: days before the observation epoch, and days whose bars arrived long after they closed, are not forward observation days: a backfill is history, not an observation
prospective.rule: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the 24 hourly bars the calendar expects for it, and every one of those bars was stored within its timeframe's lag bound of closing ({'1h': 7200000, '15m': 1800000})
prospective.window_vs_prospective: the window figure counts every stored bar after the freeze, the prospectively observed figure counts only days whose bars were stored as they closed: only the second one is an observation of the future
